matching: Actual used trainable count within2% of BOTH MTSK variants for matched GRU; no padding. Stored bytes, responsibilities, gate parameters and actual backend skip counts reported.
mask: Learned8->1 sigmoid gate, bias2 initial. Hard >=.5 forward; straight-through sigmoid derivative in training. Closed gate preserves BOTH memory and responsibilities exactly, including decay. Inference runs backend only on open samples. All MTSK arms use identical initial uniform responsibilities. Forced-open masked recurrence must match ordinary MTSK with shared weights.
controls_fit: Training-only fitted HMM/independent transitions; HMM also gets training regime labels, explicitly stronger supervision. Both filter public receipts with the declared hazard. Select comparator by minimum paid validation stream cost before final evaluation:128 total validation-selection worlds,64 per hazard. Report all controls.
oracle: Exact joint8-state filter over regime and two faults, initialized from public prior, using known true probability law and declared hazard. Receives only public events, never sampled hidden faults/regime. Feasible one-step policy with known model parameters, not long-horizon Bayes optimum.
uncertainty: 2000 family-stratified paired world-cluster bootstrap draws, globally resampling initialization seeds. Four simultaneous MTSK/masked vs GRU/selected-baseline cost intervals at Bonferroni familywise95%.384 independent test worlds, not1152 independent seed-world samples.
headroom: Public-oracle paid saving>=.1/entity with paired95% lower bound>0 versus BOTH matched GRU and validation-selected baseline; no increased aggregate fault exposure OR final faults for either hazard. Otherwise inconclusive, not success.
acceptance: A named MTSK variant needs adjusted upper cost difference<0 versus BOTH comparators, no greater aggregate fault exposure OR final faults for EVERY seed/hazard against BOTH, and adequate public-oracle headroom. No seed/variant rescue or omitted cells.
